scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction, from the gas consumer's seat: ss 10(1)-(5A), (6), (8)-(10), 11(1)-(2), 30G(1), (5), 30K, 30M(2), (5), 30N(1)-(2), (4), 30O(2)-(4), 37(2)(b), (4)-(5) and Schedule 2B paras 7, 11, 19, 24(1)(a), (2), 28(1)(a) of the revised text as at 13 November 2025. Left out on purpose: the regulators' functions, licensing, penalties (except their amount under s 30O(4)), standards of performance (set by regulations), meters and safety, land, and Parts II onward.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass has been run (see INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md). The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 10(1): premises within 23 metres are (a) premises even if also connectable by own pipe.
forks.F2: Sch 2B para 7: power from demand + 29 (deposit request + 8); notice on or after that day; earliest action notice + 7.
forks.F3: Sch 2B para 7: a late payment does not end the power (after the independent pass).
forks.F4: Sch 2B para 19 only after a para 7 cut-off.
forks.F5: 'N months from' is the corresponding date, clamped to month end.
forks.F6: s 30K(3): the s 30I(1) notice on or after the order and within the months.
forks.F7: s 30M(5): only an appeal within 42 days suspends compliance; the court's new dates not modelled.
forks.F8: s 30O(4): 10% of turnover less any penalty, floored at 0.
forks.F9: s 37(4): excess plus direction interest; nothing without excess.
